name: Brundage Swap Meet
summary: Brundage Swap Meet is a popular open-air marketplace in Bakersfield featuring over 100 vendor spaces offering diverse merchandise at affordable prices. Operating daily Tuesday through Sunday, this community-focused swap meet provides free parking and a casual shopping atmosphere for bargain hunters and families.
demographics: Brundage Swap Meet attracts a diverse, value-conscious customer base primarily from Bakersfield's working-class and middle-income neighborhoods. The typical visitor demographic skews toward families and bargain hunters seeking affordable goods, with a strong representation of Hispanic and multi-generational households. The trade area draws from East Bakersfield and surrounding communities, with shoppers looking for discounted merchandise, fresh produce, and unique finds in a casual, open-air market environment.
description: Brundage Swap Meet is a vibrant open-air marketplace located at 2207 Brundage Lane in Bakersfield, California, offering a unique shopping experience that combines the excitement of treasure hunting with everyday value. Operating Tuesday through Sunday from 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM, this bustling swap meet features over 100 vendor spaces where shoppers can discover everything from fresh produce and clothing to electronics and household goods. The facility provides a one-stop shopping destination with reasonable prices that appeal to budget-conscious families and bargain hunters throughout the Central Valley. With free parking and convenient restroom facilities, Brundage Swap Meet creates a welcoming environment where vendors and customers come together in a traditional marketplace atmosphere. The swap meet has earned a solid reputation in the community, reflected in its 4.1-star rating from over 300 reviews, making it a beloved local institution for those seeking variety, value, and the thrill of discovering unexpected deals.
